messages:
Iris: Heads-up: running a tabletop tomorrow 07:30 PDT for private onprem hardening. Focus: RBAC tighten, KMS key swap, netpol enforcement, audit ingestion. Need 2 infra + 1 sec observer.
Ken: I can do infra. Which clusters? canary-eu first, then staging.
Lina: Quick scope check: are we toggling hostPath admission and node metadata blocks as part of the exercise?
Iris: Yes. HostPath admission must be verified enabled in canary. We'll also apply a temporary iptables rule to block 169.254.169.254 on canary nodes.
Marco: RBAC change: restrict list/get on secrets for `default` ns to only `platform-*` SAs. I'll submit `rbac-tighten-4321.yaml` PR and dry-run with `kubectl auth reconcile --dry-run=server -f rbac-tighten-4321.yaml`.
Vik: KMS: using Vault transit. Steps for swap (HSM): `vault write transit/keys/ri-svc rotate` then `vault write transit/keys/ri-svc disabled=true` then `vault write transit/keys/ri-svc-promote promote=true`. Ops confirmed.
Ken: We'll exercise rollback: `vault write transit/keys/ri-svc disabled=false` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime` to refresh caches.
Lina: Netpol sample to apply (will be namespace-scoped):
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: egress-proxy-only
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: outbound-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 3128
```
Iris: Audit config: ensure kube-apiserver audit-policy includes level RequestResponse for the serviceaccount involved and that filebeat tags events with `test=onprem-tabletop-4321`. SIEM query: `GET /_search?q=test:onprem-tabletop-4321` should return within 90s.
Marco: Pentest note: older vault-proxy versions forwarded node metadata. Confirmed canary has proxy 3.4.2 (ok). Staging had 3.3.8, patch target tonight.
Vik: Detection: create SIEM rule `MissingRBACEvent` -> triggers if no `action=rbac:modify` event within 2m of change. PagerDuty escalation on hit.
Ken: I'll deploy the iptables daemonset to canary at 06:30 and apply RBAC dry-run at 06:45. If dry-run clean, apply in staging at 07:00.
Iris: sec-bot: create incident TABLETOP-2026-04-14 and attach runbook /ops/runbooks/onprem-hardening-tabletop.md
sec-bot: Incident TABLETOP-2026-04-14 created (status=scheduled). Responders=[Ken,Marco,Lina].
Lina: One more: double-check that kubelet `--protect-kernel-defaults` present and `HostPath` admission plugin enabled. I'll run apiserver flags check before the window.
Iris: Great. Keep runbook notes minimal and label artifacts with `test=onprem-tabletop-4321`. If any unexpected telemetry shows token-forwarding, stop and escalate.
Ken: Got it. See you all tomorrow.
